submitter: bugs_open/333 lane — closing the door's residual, ROUND 2 (2026-08-25), resubmitted on the same correlation
rationale: ROUND 2. Round 1 came back REVISE gated by `guardian` (HIGH) with a MEDIUM from `bug_historian`. Both objections changed something: one produced a measurement, the other changed the code. GUARDIAN HIGH (seam routing is a behaviour change on a write path six audit pipelines share, unexamined): the examination now exists. [MEASURED 2026-08-25, live+archive, 30 days] the six producers filed 579 findings; under the seam's anti-churn brake, 22 (3.8%) would have been born `unresolved` and 6 deferred in-window. The 22's terminal siblings split 41 complete / 6 failed — repaired-then-refound-within-7-days loops, which is the brake's stated design case (RFC_048 §6b: detectors re-finding a fault whose fixer reports done without fixing; deferring those re-dispatches a futile fix every cycle). The two clusters are a design-audit burst on 08-11 and visual-design-audit on 08-17/20. THE OWNER EXPLICITLY SIGNED OFF FULL ROUTING WITH THIS CENSUS BEFORE THEM (2026-08-25, in-session ruling), which is the guardian's named alternative to scoping ('or explicitly signed off per consuming pipeline' — the owner owns all six). On the batch-atomicity question: the previous code was per-row autocommitted ExecContext with NO transaction — there was no batch atomicity to lose, and the created/skipped counting semantics across the findings array are unchanged. BUG_HISTORIAN MEDIUM (the escalation skip leaves no durable record — nothing for a future audit to find if an owned page genuinely lost content): FIXED IN CODE. The skip now writes the platform's established per-page trail via emitOwnedPageReviewItem (owned_page_guard.go) — the same emitter reconcile_site_plan and the composition guards use for exactly this refusal class: one row per page (ON CONFLICT), key owned_page_review:<page>, spec naming reason and refused_by, remedy text pointing at the tool pipeline. So the same question ('is this owned-page condition expected?') now has ONE durable answer shape at both sites: an existing finding parks at the door; a would-be escalation leaves the per-page review row. Emit-and-let-the-door-decide was considered and rejected by the owner's ruling AND the architecture seat's round-1 note for the same reason: a parked needs_page:<name> row is non-terminal and holds a dedup slot deliberately shared with reconcile_site_plan. Mutation-proven: dropping the emit fails TestEscalateRerenderToWriter_OwnedPage_SkipsEmit (unmet INSERT expectation). On 'is owned⇒empty-normal a generalisation from 12 of 13': the guard does not generalise — it reads THIS page's rebuild_policy through pageIsOwnedForGuard at skip time, per instance (the distinction from bugs_closed/044's name-heuristic deferral), and all 13 measured rows carry the same spec.reason='content_data_backfill' from the same emit path; the '12 of 13' split concerned the PARENT run's trigger, not the mechanism. EDITQUALITY lows: dropOnConflict is the seam's existing conflictPolicy enum constant (load_work_item_actions.go:1599) — the code is committed (0ad313f02) and the full actions suite is green; the pageID at rerender_page_sections_action.go:196-215 is a local of the ACTION function and is not in scope inside escalateRerenderToWriter (a package-level helper both callers reach with (siteID, pageName)), so the lookup is not duplicating an available value. DEBUG_HISTORIAN (deploy verification unspecified): it is specified — the lane RUNBOOK §'Verifying the residual fixes' pins both compiled log literals for pod-grep with a must-be-absent control and gives the post-roll queries with demand controls. TOOLING_PROVENANCE low: acknowledged; the decision trail lives in the lane's standing five + register WII-028 (synced), per this lane's established channels.

plan.risks: (1) anti-churn brake now applies to audit findings: a finding whose key saw 2 terminal siblings in 7 days is born unresolved instead of detected. Accepted deliberately — that is the seam's contract for every detector producer, and the door runs BEFORE the brake so owned-page rows park first (WII-028's ordering argument). (2) per-finding transactions add BeginTx/Commit per row where there was one bare Exec; audit batches are tens of findings, not thousands — cost accepted for the log-and-continue contract. (3) the escalation guard adds 2 reads (PK-shaped) per escalation attempt; escalations are rare (13 in 14h fleet-wide was an anomaly). (4) 8 raw-INSERT writers remain (admin handlers and non-content producers); the handler's own refusal (301) stays their backstop, unchanged, and none has been measured firing on owned pages since the door went live. (5) the review emit adds one deduped insert per owned-page skip; owned_page_review rows land at needs_human_review, a queue the owner has ruled should not fill — bounded per PAGE by the ON CONFLICT key, and this emitter is the established trail every other owned-page refusal site already writes, so it adds no new queue pressure class.
